summary: Frontend-only testing for redesigned public Landing page and decluttered logged-in TopNav (grouped dropdowns). Verified landing renders with all data-testids (hero CTAs, 4 pillars, hero jump chips, CTA), logged in as demo_web@safeqr.com/demo1234, verified nav-dashboard/nav-safety/nav-family direct links, opened Vehicle & QR (nav-assets-btn) and More (nav-more-btn) dropdowns, verified each of the 10 dropdown links navigates to the correct route with non-blank content, verified click-outside closes the dropdown, verified account menu -> nav-settings works, and verified logout returns to landing. 36/37 test assertions passed; the 1 failure was a test-script URL-match issue on logout (functional logout worked and returned to landing/login).
critical_code_review_comments: TopNav.jsx has duplicate data-testid="logout-btn" on both the org/dealer top-level logout button (lines 43,50) and inside the standard-user account dropdown (line 111). Only one path renders at a time so it isn't a runtime bug today, but if roles ever change or an admin/org+standard hybrid is added, selector collisions will break tests. Recommend unique testids (e.g. logout-btn-org, logout-btn-dealer, logout-btn-account).

Landing.jsx (~304 lines) is close to acceptable but the large static arrays (pillars/personas/testimonials/faqs) could be extracted to a data module to keep the component under ~200 lines and improve reusability.
TopNav.jsx uses a document-level click listener via useEffect but only closes when target is outside .nav-drop; that is correct. Consider closing on Escape key for accessibility.
The 'nav-a-vehicles' item points to /dashboard (same as Home). Consider a dedicated /vehicles route or removing the item from the Vehicle & QR menu to avoid two entries that go to Home.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page and TopNav dropdown navigation are working end-to-end. All 10 grouped-menu items (nav-a-* and nav-m-*) route correctly to /tags, /cards, /theft-protection, /safe-zones, /alerts, /incidents, /community, /subscription, /support, and /dashboard. Account menu (nav-settings, logout-btn) works. Duplicate data-testid=logout-btn is a latent risk. No console errors observed on any visited route.
